examples.name: FGFR1 potency threshold

bound_support.applicability_rationale: The claim reports that representative FGFR inhibitors block FGFR activity at concentrations less than 20 nM. This is a measured observation of potent FGFR inhibition. For the task of identifying a compound that engages FGFR1, a potency at least as good as these representative inhibitors is desirable. The inference is at_least_the_reported_value: compounds with pChEMBL >= 7.7 are at least as potent as the reported threshold.

interpretation.measurement: Representative FGFR inhibitors block FGFR activity at concentrations less than 20 nM.
interpretation.population_rationale: The candidates are kinase inhibitors being screened for FGFR1 engagement. The reported 20 nM threshold is from representative FGFR inhibitors, a relevant reference class. Requiring pChEMBL >= 7.7 ensures the candidate is at least as potent as these inhibitors.

examples.name: Predicted volume of distribution at steady state
Predicted volume of distribution at steady state

bound_support.applicability_rationale: The Lipinski Rule states that lipophilicity not >5 is associated with acceptable oral bioavailability; this threshold applies to oral drug candidates.

The claim reports that vorolanib inhibits VEGFR2 with an IC50 of 52 ng/g. This is a measured value. For the task of identifying a compound that engages VEGFR2, a potency at least as good as this value is desirable. The inference is at_most_the_reported_value: compounds with IC50 <= 52 ng/g are at least as potent as vorolanib.

interpretation.measurement: Vorolanib inhibits VEGFR2 with an IC50 of 52 ng/g.
interpretation.population_rationale: The candidates are kinase inhibitors being screened for VEGFR2 engagement. The reported 52 ng/g is from a TKI that inhibits VEGFR2. Requiring IC50 <= 52 ng/g ensures the candidate is at least as potent as vorolanib.
